contracts.source: Applied Materials press release: Applied Materials and Intel Collaborate to Accelerate (10-06-2026)
contracts.signal: Applied Materials announced it is working with Intel to accelerate development of next-generation transistors, interconnects and advanced packaging technologies, bringing together Applied's EPIC Center in Silicon Valley and Intel's R&D campus in Hillsboro, Oregon. Teams are collaborating on next-generation materials, process technologies and device architectures for advanced logic nodes targeting AI workloads, spanning front-end and back-end-of-line advancements including interconnect scaling, and on advanced packaging technologies for Foveros-based 3D stacking (higher interconnect density, improved power delivery, enhanced thermal performance). Prabu Raja, President of Applied's Semiconductor Products Group: Applied looks forward to working closely with Intel 'as a founding partner of the EPIC Center'. Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan called Applied Materials 'an important partner'. The release says the EPIC Center is scheduled to be operationally ready this year. No financial terms or volumes are stated.
contracts.type: partnership (EPIC Center founding partner, joint R&D)
